description: This file defines the SaveEmploymentStatusController class within the OrangeHRM Admin module. It extends an abstract Vue controller, and mainly manages the component rendering based on request attributes, handling the logic to differentiate between editing and saving employment status entities.

classes.name: SaveEmploymentStatusController
classes.description: Controller responsible for preparing a Vue component for saving or editing employment status data based on request parameters.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component based on whether an 'id' attribute exists in the request. Sets up an editing component with the specific employment status ID or a save component for creating new entries.
